source.observed_bounds_note: Additional 20fps event sampling supports a conservative 0.10s observation interval; sample raster indices are not exact native-frame event timing. Original label is preserved separately.
direct_pixels_inspected: last visually connected neck or shaft

time_mapping.source_event_anchor_type: midpoint of direct pixel observation interval
time_mapping.mapping_limit: Semantic phase mapping, not pointwise kinematic reproduction. Entire source span is represented without loops or padding; laboratory elapsed time is not simulated time.

observations: Source shows a smooth round reduced section clamped in opposed jaws.
Little visible uniform deformation and no pronounced plastic neck precede a transverse separation.
Source upper fixture continues moving after rupture; finite postrupture motion is not reinterpreted as zero.
authored_assumptions: Dimensionless relative geometry reconstructed from pixels; no absolute dimensions, material grade, force, strain-rate or constitutive law inferred.
Lower jaw fixed and upper jaw supplies loading; final rupture triggers immediate stop in accordance with selected DESIGN condition. This changes apparatus control relative to source.
Volume-preserving axial stretch with radius proportional to inverse square root of local axial stretch; fracture face detail is qualitative and not a proof of cup-cone or microscopic mechanism.

Fracture faces are complementary, paired interior caps until damage opens. Interface connection is judged by actual evaluated coincident vertices; Blender mesh-container separation is not used as component evidence.
Finite crack opening is created by last loading displacement while a residual interface ligament remains; no specimen section is removed, no whole-half postfracture translation or recoil is applied.
Background, apparatus detail and lighting are simplified to preserve specimen visibility.
Stage1 altered values are author-selected discrete examples, not source measurement or a calibrated material response.

Center +0.75 initial material units (14.706% of the authored 5.1-unit gauge length) is an author-selected bounded one-sided offset. Full crack influence envelope [0.15,1.35] stays within [-2.55,2.55]. Width, small stretch, original near-planar crack face and event timing remain unchanged. Material ring spacing adapts to include the moved seam exactly; this is a discretization consequence, not a second behavioral parameter.
unknowns: Exact alloy, heat treatment and strain-rate.
Absolute specimen dimensions and formal experimental gauge length.
Subframe rupture initiation and microscopic crack path.
Quantitative relation between crosshead motion, gauge extension and machine compliance.
Three-dimensional trajectory and elastic unloading in the recorded experiment.
New continuous video visibility, naturalness and six labels await final rendering, main-agent viewing and independent review.
Source does not calibrate the selected neck amplitude or one-sided fracture displacement.
Continuous parameter range, arbitrary coupled combinations and training release are not approved.

baseline_reference.note: Old accepted metadata remains unchanged; all 600 frames are compared separately, parameterization does not regenerate or replace accepted bytes.

geometry.surface_detail_mechanism: authored qualitative shape, not a proven fracture mechanism

motion.upper_jaw: source-informed loading displacement, freezes at completed rupture
motion.opening_note: Complementary surfaces open progressively from front to rear under last loading displacement; no region is removed and no rigid fragment recoil is added. Gap is authored qualitative finite opening, not measured source displacement. Ductile gap/original diameter=0.446 and gap/terminal neck diameter~1.0 versus visible source postrupture ratios~0.65 and~1.3. Source ratios include source postrupture motion; here finite opening is authored during final loading to make fracture visible before selected load stop.

full_generation_configuration.saved_scene_animation: baked absolute shape keys and ordinary jaw keys; no external script required

neck_parameter.coupling: Axial positions integrate lambda over original material coordinates; radius=original radius/sqrt(lambda); loading jaw follows integrated end position. Paired fracture surfaces use the resulting same seam radius and match before crack opening.

engineering_input_guard.reason: Larger amplitudes increase specimen and crosshead excursion beyond the baseline; the conservative input upper bound preserves current fixed-camera framing. Larger-value framing has not been verified.

neck_parameter.scope_note: Guarded inputs do not establish physical plausibility, label validity, or user acceptance of a new video; each changed value requires its own applicable checks and review.

stage1_parameters.coupling: Moved seam is included exactly in initial material grid. Ductile stretch, radial contraction, fracture geometry, opening fade and jaw endpoint all use same material center; no postbreak translation is introduced. Gaussian has infinite tails; 3sigma bounds are a field envelope, not hard support.
stage1_parameters.scope: Discrete candidate inputs and engineering guards; no physical calibration or continuous range acceptance.

measured_events.method: All 600 actual evaluated edge graphs with coincident vertex welding at 1e-5 units; this is geometric contact connectivity, not bonded FEM topology. First opening uses measured paired fracture-ring gap >1e-5.

prefracture_measurements.area_definition: Transverse xy projected polygon area of same evaluated material ring relative to frame1; exclude entire +/-0.6 material crack-affected zone once first opening occurs. Neck-center area at final connected state is unavailable in progressive crack zone; intact area minimum is reported separately. Axial material-marker projection subtracts mean paired fracture-seam gap to exclude crack opening; also report raw span, subtracted gap and two same-material local segments.
prefracture_measurements.material_origin: initial undeformed axial coordinates; authored gauge differs from unknown formal source gauge

technical_checks.measurement_method: Evaluated mesh positions and actual edge graph with coincident interface vertex welding at 1e-5 units; two containers do not predetermine component count. Interior paired fracture caps are hidden while interface is unbroken. Not an FEM model.
technical_checks.penetration_scope: Corresponding fracture point gaps and jaw contact/embedding only. No whole-mesh triangle self-intersection proof; clamping contact is intended.
technical_checks.volume_scope: Evaluated closed-cap geometry; overlap and opened progressive fracture introduce geometric approximation, not exact incompressible mechanics.
technical_checks.key_preview_developer_view: Developer opened final key PNG only; final continuous playback and independent judgment remain pending.
